instruction: Your store manager asked you to verify one product before a catalog update, but the CMS has many menus and fields. Open the CMS admin site in Google Chrome, sign in with username `admin` and password `admin1234`, find the product record for `Joust Duffle Bag`, and fill in the Value column in the `cms_product_record.xlsx` spreadsheet on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Open the self-hosted CMS admin site in Google Chrome.
Sign in with username `admin` and password `admin1234`.
Navigate to the catalog or products area without changing any product data.
Fill the Value column for the prepared keys: ID, Thumbnail, Name, Type, Attribute Set, SKU, Price, Quantity, Salable Quantity, Visibility, Status, Websites, Last Updated At, and Action.
Record the product values, including Name `Joust Duffle Bag`, Type `Simple Product`, SKU `24-MB01`, Price `$34.00`, Quantity `100.0000`.

result.command: python -c "from openpyxl import load_workbook; from pathlib import Path; p=Path.home()/'Desktop'/'cms_product_record.xlsx'; wb=load_workbook(p, data_only=True); ws=wb.active; print('\n'.join(f'{ws.cell(r,1).value}: {ws.cell(r,2).value}' for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1)))"
